title: Sprint 05 — Explicit one-dimensional fiber
subtitle: Task-space scalar fibers on the validated pointing parent
sprint_status: Closed — Check-in 5 CONTINUE WITH CHANGED SCOPE
warning: Check-in 5 is approved with changed scope. Fibers are candidate slices, not canonical. This readout does not authorize spherical RRRR, McCarthy–Soh, or exact UR.
claim: One independent task-space scalar h=n·d on p=p0 and q6=q6* defines a regular, reversible local one-dimensional fiber whose pointing image is noncollapsed.
checkin_rationale: Primary and alternate fibers exist on IP and UR-like seeds. They are candidate slices, not architecture-derived canonical fibers. Joint-freeze control is distinct.

experiments.title: Independence of h = n · d
experiments.expected: Primary h=n·d is independent at both regular seeds: rank 4 / nullity 1 and dh/dq6=0
experiments.observed: IntersectingPairsAligned6R: rank=4, null=1, dh_dq6=0.000e+00, independent=True; URLikeAligned6R: rank=4, null=1, dh_dq6=0.000e+00, independent=True

experiments.title: Intersecting-pairs sequential fiber
experiments.expected: Sequential ±σ fiber is regular, reversible from the endpoint, and has a noncollapsed pointing image of local rank 1
experiments.observed: IntersectingPairsAligned6R: n_accepted=9, n_failed=0, reverse_eq=2.922e-08, reverse_ed=7.525e-09, from_end=True, image_dmax=6.150e-02, local_rank1=True

experiments.title: UR-like sequential fiber
experiments.expected: Sequential ±σ fiber is regular, reversible from the endpoint, and has a noncollapsed pointing image of local rank 1

experiments.title: Alternate task-space h artifact control
experiments.expected: Alternate task-space h'=n'·d remains a regular reversible pointing fiber; q2-freeze control is a distinct path
experiments.observed: IntersectingPairsAligned6R: alt_ind=True, alt_rev_ed=1.430e-08, freeze_dq=1.482e-02, distinct=True; URLikeAligned6R: alt_ind=True, alt_rev_ed=3.300e-09, freeze_dq=1.557e-01, distinct=True

experiments.title: Independent-step fiber refinement
experiments.expected: With max_microstep=None over the same σ travel, reverse tracking succeeds and both joint and pointing return errors decrease when Δσ is halved; shared-σ samples stay within 1e-3. Tight 1e-6/5e-8 reverse gates apply to microstepped runs (028/029), not this independent-step refinement diagnostic
